purpose: Teach: 実地/旅費/引数/業態/格付け/送迎/旅客/打ち込ん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の、本気で、絶対、実地、絶対、経験、絶対、積め、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — you need to accumulate real, hands-on research experience. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Steady, measured. Direct eye contact. The weight of expectation delivered without harshness. A pause before the final sentence, letting it land. Not a command — a request that carries authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の旅費、本気で、絶対、研究室から、絶対、支給、絶対、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful the lab is covering my conference travel expenses.
lines.style: Respectful but not servile. Clear and direct. A slight nod on the opening word. Genuine gratitude without overstatement — he means it but doesn't perform it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プログラムの引数、本気で、絶対、研究にも、絶対、活用、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Apply what you learn about program arguments directly to your research. This matters.
lines.style: Slight forward lean. Practical, no-nonsense tone. The words land with quiet conviction. Not aggressive — just clear about priorities. A pause after the final sentence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新業態の研究、本気で、絶対、興味、絶対、深まっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Working on this new area has deepened my interest in the research. I appreciate that.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm barely contained. Earnest but not effusive. A slight lift in the middle on 'deepened.' Steady eye contact. He's speaking to what matters to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の格付け、本気で、絶対、上位を、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Aim for the top tier in your paper ratings. I won't settle for less, and neither should you.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Direct, almost conversational. A micro-pause before 'top tier' — weighing the words. The final sentence carries the real instruction. Measured breathing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授の送迎、本気で、絶対、私が、絶対、引き受けてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll take care of your transportation to and from campus — you focus on the work.
lines.style: Quiet determination. He's offering something practical as support. No fanfare. A slight lean forward on 'I'll take care of it.' Respectful but self-assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 旅客機の航空学、本気で、絶対、研究、絶対、面白いぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The aerodynamics of commercial aircraft — there's something fascinating there for your research. Explore it.
lines.style: A spark of genuine interest in his voice. More animated than before, but still controlled. Leaning back slightly, seeing the possibility. The final word is both permission and encouragement. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究に、本気で、絶対、打ち込んでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to dedicate myself completely to this research. Thank you for believing in me.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Deep breath before speaking. Each word deliberate and grounded. A slight tremor of earnestness beneath the formality — he's committing to something that matters. Trailing slightly on the final phrase.
